title: Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Repayment of a Duplicate Claim Payment
content:
Under the Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan, a second claim payment issued in error after the approval was already paid, once the tenant has cashed it, is settled by the tenant repaying the claim money paid above the claim's re-settled entitlement, and the repaid amount is recorded as a void of that second payment with the reason `issued_in_error`.

## What the repayment does on the records

The repayment is recorded on the claim's handling history as a repayment void of the claim payment it reverses, with the void reason issued in error and the date it is taken, and the net claim money shown as paid on the tenant's protection plan falls by the amount repaid.

## Function: `repay_duplicate_claim_payment_968ba4e6`

**How it is invoked.** The repayment comes from the tenant's own funds, so it is the customer's own act: the agent unlocks `repay_duplicate_claim_payment_968ba4e6` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters**

- `claim_id` — the protection claim number whose second payment is being repaid, as shown in the claim lookup the agent reads out to the tenant; identifier text.
- `reference_event_id` — the reference number of the claim payment event this repayment reverses, as shown in the claim's handling history the agent reads out to the tenant; identifier text.
- `amount` — the repayment the tenant pays, in USD; a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; no currency sign.

**Return.** A receipt with `claim_event_id` (the reference number of the repayment entry), `claim_id` (the claim repaid), `reference_event_id` (the claim payment reversed), `amount` (the amount repaid, USD, 2 decimal places), `void_reason` (always `issued_in_error`), `event_date` (the date recorded, YYYY-MM-DD) and `status` (`repayment_recorded` when the repayment has been taken).

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A claim approved at 1,250.00 was paid by direct deposit and then, in error, by a mailed check of 1,250.00 that the tenant cashed. With a re-settled entitlement of, say, 1,250.00, the tenant runs the function with the claim number, the mailed check's payment reference and an `amount` of 1250.00; the receipt shows `void_reason` `issued_in_error`.
